_comment: Demo asset catalog. One entry per dtype, plus one extra, so the CHECK constraint in build_assets_db.py is exercised by every allowed value. Replace the paths with your own; the shape is what the scripts depend on.

assets.name: Project Profile
assets.value: What Helios is: owner, stage, interfaces, sharp edges
assets.context: any session that touches the project

assets.name: Style Rules
assets.value: Eight WHEN/USE/AVOID rules with the failure each one prevents
assets.risk: stale means wrong tone with no signal

assets.name: Constraints
assets.value: Three HARD and three SOFT rules, each with its source incident
assets.risk: deleting one silently removes a gate's justification

assets.name: Knowledge Index
assets.value: Compressed view of the three source files; rebuilt, never edited

assets.name: Endpoint Implementation
assets.risk: append-only; history matters more than tidiness

assets.name: Owner Contact
assets.value: Who to ask about which subsystem
assets.risk: not recoverable if nobody writes it down

assets.name: Postmortems
assets.value: One file per incident; the source field of every HARD constraint

assets.name: Release Notes
assets.value: What shipped, when, and the command that verified it
assets.risk: not recoverable once the context is gone

assets.name: Session Transcripts
assets.value: Append-only raw record; the rebuild source for everything above

assets.name: Harness Config
assets.value: Path resolution and the hook wiring; a broken config disables every gate
assets.risk: corruption disables all gates at once

assets.name: Asset Catalog
assets.value: This file: the inventory of assets and their risk

assets.name: Gate Log
assets.value: Every gate firing, with the trigger that fired it — the corpus for fixing false positives
assets.risk: append-only; a gate log with no trigger recorded cannot be debugged
